name: etcd
description: Distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system
one_liner: The reliable, shared 'memory' that keeps distributed systems like Kubernetes in sync.
buyer: A platform engineering team running their own Kubernetes clusters who needs expertise to avoid outages.
business_use_cases: A Kubernetes consultancy offers 'health check and backup strategy' audits to companies running self-managed clusters, since failures here are a common cause of cluster outages.
A managed-infrastructure provider bundles operations and monitoring for it into their Kubernetes-as-a-service offering.
An SRE trainer sells incident-response workshops specifically on disaster recovery for it.

money_ideas.idea: Paid health-check and disaster-recovery audit for companies running self-managed Kubernetes

steal_this: Offer a fixed-price backup-and-disaster-recovery audit to startups running their own Kubernetes — most have never actually tested restoring a backup.
